section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
title: Sound quality bad when tape player played - Troubleshooting

content.text: (b) Sound quality bad when tape player played.

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for tape player sound quality issues. Starts with checking if sound improves with another tape, then proceeds to cleaning head if needed.

steps.question: Does sound improve with another tape?
Clean head. Does sound improve? (See note for cleaning procedure.)

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for speaker and tape player issues. Checks speaker installation, vibration noise, and temporary speaker replacement.

steps.question: Is speaker correctly installed (loose or too tight)?
steps.no: Install correctly. If speaker frame bent, replace.

steps.question: Does vibration sound come from around speaker?

content.description: Diagram showing tape head assembly with labeled components: Pinch Roller, Head, and Capstan. The illustration shows a front view of the tape mechanism.

items: Raise the cassette door with four finger. Next, using a pencil or like object, push in the guide.
Using a cleaning pin or cotton application soaked in alcohol, clean the head surface, pinch rollers and capstans.
